## A blank slate for testing

Use this page to test code generated by an AI assistant. Copy a complete R/Shiny application into the editor, run it, inspect the result, and revise it in small steps.

Before using real data, remove confidential information and confirm that the code uses the correct files, packages, filters, and business definitions.
